host_about:
I was an Airbnb host in Cincinnati, OH in 2011 & 2012 where I earned Superhost status and glowing reviews from dozens of happy guests, but I let my ex keep that Airbnb profile when we split so he could keep hosting in that house -- too bad he didn't even keep up with hosting after that! Oh well!

Ben and I started hosting together in Las Vegas in 2013 and we have been married since 2014. We have hosted thousands of guests in several cities from more than 50 countries -- sometimes in private rooms in our homes, and sometimes whole home rentals, so it's been quite an adventure thus far!

Ben and I feel like we are more than just "married" because we are partners in everything we do -- IT consulting, Airbnb, real estate investing, and anything else that strikes our interests!

We currently split our time between our homes in Nashville, TN, and Cleveland, OH, so sometimes we may be staying in the upper level of the Nashville house, and sometimes we may be back in Cleveland where we also host out of our guest house on occasion. 

We lost our giant fur baby Goliath to a ruptured cardiac tumor very suddenly in the summer of 2021 but we just recently felt our hearts were healed enough to welcome another American Mastiff in our family -- his name is Tank. At the Nashville house he lives in the upper level with us and he mostly stays in the fenced front yard, but sometimes we go play in the larger un-fenced back and side yards -- we do have over an acre of land after all!

I was formerly an IT consultant full time, but these days I split my time between hosting, managing our Airbnb's and long-term rental properties, renovating new rental properties, working in our gardens, and working in our woodshop in Cleveland. I also love to explore new cities, go hiking, and I'm looking forward to taking Tank on adventures once he isn't such a young pup!

And last but not least, I love yoga and can recommend wonderful studios nearby our Nashville and our Cleveland Airbnb locations if you need a yoga sanctuary while you're in town!

description: Take a morning stroll and enjoy the sunrise from the riverfront park and pedestrian bridge. host_about:
Hi! 

I live, work, and play in downtown Nashville - I love it here! I moved to Nashville eight years ago to work for a software marketing company. I wish that I moved here sooner. I joke that I'm going to have a t-shirt or bumper sticker made which reads, "Not a native, but I got here as quick as I could!" 

I have lived in three different downtown Nashville locations; I've experienced the features and benefits unique to each location. This townhouse's area is my favorite so far and it is where I call home. It's walkable to all that downtown has to offer but far enough away that I can escape from the busy noise of the high-rise business/tourist district. 

I'm honored to welcome travelers here and I hope they'll enjoy the location as much as I do. I'm happy to offer local travel hints and answer any questions about the property or Nashville. I'm presently developing a website with tips and 'must-sees' (ask for the link once booked.) 

...Go ahead and ask me where my favorite nearby place to get a steak, hot chicken, BBQ, or preferred place to sample some Nashville made whiskey or bear brewery, or my best secret hidden bar off the beaten path or just my favorite spot for some good ole live music...and just watch my face light up as I go into details..! 

Have questions? Let me know how I can help!

Best, 
David

host_about:

Sure the tourist spots are a must, but get to know where the locals go and you really learn about the place you are visiting.

There is a reason NashVegas is the "It-City."

Best, 
David

Hi! 

I live, work, and play in downtown Nashville - I love it here! I moved to Nashville eight years ago to work for a software marketing company. I wish that I moved here sooner. I joke that I'm going to have a t-shirt or bumper sticker made which reads, "Not a native, but I got here as quick as I could!"

This townhouse's area is my favorite so far and it is where I call home. It's walkable to all that downtown has to offer but far enough away that I can escape from the busy noise of the high-rise business/tourist district. 

I'm honored to welcome travelers here and I hope they'll enjoy the location as much as I do. I'm happy to offer local travel hints and answer any questions about the property or Nashville. I'm presently developing a website with tips and 'must-sees' (ask for the link once booked.) 

...Go ahead and ask me where my favorite nearby place to get a steak, hot chicken, BBQ, or preferred place to sample some Nashville made whiskey or bear brewery, or my best secret hidden bar off the beaten path or just my favorite spot for some good ole live music...and just watch my face light up as I go into details..! 

Have questions? Let me know how I can help!

Best, 
David

name: East Nashville Attic-walking distance to 5 Points
description:
Settle into this 1926 designer appointed “attic” apartment within walking distance of all East Nashville has to offer!

Only 1.5 miles from the river, Nissan Stadium and Broadway and within walking distance of the famed East Nashville 5 Points. You will be surrounded by local restaurants, coffee shops, bars, thrift shops and so much more. It’s the perfect home base for your Nashville stay!
host_about:
My husband Dylan and I were both raised in the greater Nashville area and love living close to downtown in East Nashville.  We are high school sweethearts (so 1950's) and lived within a half mile of each other growing up. We have 2 dogs, Ellie & Leti (named after 1st Ladies), and a porch cat Goldie who you may or may not meet. We love going to local festivals and street fairs, and also just hanging at home cooking dinner and binge watching the newest Netflix series.  We are of course Preds and Titans fans and enjoy going to as many games as we can!  We hope you enjoy our work in progress!

I also help to manage my moms cottage at her 3rd (my sister, brother & I will be the 4th!) generation farm in Jasper, Arkansas. After helping out with restoration of the house when I was 13, I felt a deep connection to it and the area, and since then have grown up with my siblings going there for Christmas’s and other fun river trips throughout the years. I was given my first name from the surname of our family who helped to settle the area. We hope you make lasting family memories of your own there just like we have!

description:
Park for free and walk to everything downtown Nashville has to offer from The Little Zen Studio Apartment.

host_about:
Hi! 

I live, work, and play in downtown Nashville - I love it here! I moved to Nashville eight years ago to work for a software marketing company. I wish that I moved here sooner. I joke that I'm going to have a t-shirt or bumper sticker made which reads, "Not a native, but I got here as quick as I could!" 

I have lived in three different downtown Nashville locations; I've experienced the features and benefits unique to each location. This townhouse's area is my favorite so far and it is where I call home. It's walkable to all that downtown has to offer but far enough away that I can escape from the busy noise of the high-rise business/tourist district. 

I'm honored to welcome travelers here and I hope they'll enjoy the location as much as I do. I'm happy to offer local travel hints and answer any questions about the property or Nashville. I'm presently developing a website with tips and 'must-sees' (ask for the link once booked.) 

...Go ahead and ask me where my favorite nearby place to get a steak, hot chicken, BBQ, or preferred place to sample some Nashville made whiskey or bear brewery, or my best secret hidden bar off the beaten path or just my favorite spot for some good ole live music...and just watch my face light up as I go into details..! 

Have questions? Let me know how I can help!

Best, 
David

description:

host_about:
While I have stayed in an Airbnb a handful of times, most of my interaction has by far been hosting, with upwards of 200 bookings. I've enjoyed providing a service in a town with too few over-priced hotels! I got married May of 2018, at which time we purchased the house with the listing you were looking at.

Alright, you ready for the Fast Five?

1. I work full time as a real estate investor and simply love it. After years of different jobs, I've finally found something that makes sense for me. I could talk about it all day if you'll let me! You've been warned.

2. I love athletics. Basketball, volleyball, spikeball, snow/wake/longboarding, ultimate frisbee, anything really! I think I love the thrill of striving to get better at whatever I get into.

3.  Board game nights, especially strategy board games, always have a way of filling up my tank. I can get lost in the hours with friendly camaraderie and competition. Your typical introvert that loves to think, and think hard!

4. My life used to be all about music. Playing in bands, worship bands, songwriting, and later on even working in the music industry at BMI. These days I hardly pick up a guitar but once a month!

5. I like fixing... anything. Cars, motorcycles, appliances. It feels so good to figure out why the problem is happening and then fix it. Sometimes I try to fix people too, but the Lord is working on my heart to keep me in my place. Maybe some day I can channel that into coaching or teaching things such as personal finance or life skills.

Our family works extremely hard to provide our guests a luxury experience (at a price point for everyone) by combining perfect accommodations, unrivaled service plus concierge access to the local area. 

We love hosting weekend getaways, large groups for Bachelor/Bachelorette parties, extended stays for traveling professionals. Anyone with goodness in their heart are always welcome at any of our homes.

We have a small staff that helps answer any question 24/7, but we're a very small family company with a passion for providing an incredible guest experience.

We look forward to hosting you!
Cheers- Christian (big bro) + Shannon and John (little bro) + Lauren (VentureBNB)
